

== Original and later persona-title states ==
The printed title changed from “Lando's Luxury Yacht” to “Lady Luck”. The game text shown on the two inspected slips is unchanged. Both source images have been checked. The original has its own full card article at [[Lando's Luxury Yacht (V)]]. Compilation dates do not establish the precise effective date of each state. The dated source-history audit remains open.
